item.title: Happy Half Hour Episode 196: Super Week
item.description: Today on the Happy Half Hour, Darin and Kassidy react to the Seattle Seahawks defeating the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX, recap NFL Honors, celebrate Luke Kuechly making the NFL Hall of Fame, and so much more!

item.title: Anish Shroff with Hall of Fame Linebacker, Luke Kuechly
item.description: Hall of Fame linebacker, Luke Kuechly, speaks with Panthers play-by-play announcer, Anish Shroff, about his induction to the NFL Hall of Fame, how he found out, who impacted his life along the journey, being a good teammate, the importance of preparation, and so much more!

item.title: JJ & Luke Episode 1: Takes Two to Tango
item.description: In their first episode together, JJ and Luke break down the NFL Combine experience - and what actually happens inside team interviews. Plus, a quick dive into franchise tag season, what it means for the Carolina Panthers, and the balance between fit and money in free agency.

item.title: Happy Half Hour Episode 197: 2026 NFL Combine
item.description: Today on the Happy Half Hour, Darin and Kassidy are on location to recap all the Panther press conferences from Tuesday, react to Brad Idzik being named offensive play caller, and so much more!

item.title: Anish Shroff with Executive VP of Football Operations, Brandt Tilis
item.description: Executive VP of Football Operations, Brandt Tilis, speaks with Panthers play-by-play announcer, Anish Shroff, about the path that led him to a career in the NFL, how he hopes to approach the NFL Draft as well as Free Agency, and so much more!

item.title: Anish Shroff with Head Coach Dave Canales
item.description: Head Coach, Dave Canales, speaks with Panthers play-by-play announcer, Anish Shroff, to talk about the decision to hand over play calling duties to OC Brad Idzik, the perspective that Darrell Bevell brings to the staff, and so much more!

item.title: JJ & Luke Episode 2: Free Agency Frenzy
item.description: In their second episode, JJ and Luke discuss the start of free agency week, how it may impact the Panthers and the rest of the league.
